parsed.text: This packet reports fallible location distributions over 4×4 local grids for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Current estimates (represented times and origins are in the packet): p0 current shows n0 with a strong blue peak at cell [0,1] and a strong red peak at [0,3]; n1 and n2 are uniform for both roles; p0 n3 peaks are blue at [1,2] and red at [0,1]. p1 current matches p0 for n0–n2 and is uniform at n3. Copied prior records in origins are retained, not new estimates; candidate command records are conditional projections, not events that have already occurred. Across candidate commands, node n3 shows the main variation: in p0 the blue peak stays at [1,2] and red at [0,1] while peak probabilities and spread change with commands k0/k1/k2; in p1 candidates k1 and k2 shift concentrations (k1 places blue mass on four cells [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3] and red on four cells [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1], while k2 concentrates on blue [1,2] and red [0,1]). No physical presence or external facts are inferred; numbers describe only the supplied distributions.
